entry.title: New: dsh-liquid-glass-balance-card
entry.summary: Draggable 3D liquid-glass floating card for the DSH web GUI: DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend/token stats (today/yesterday/7d/30d/all), adjustable glass/3D/color controls, and one-click top-up. Exact install spec: dsh-liquid-glass-balance-card. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
